A student makes two statements about the waves.

When the waves reflect from the barrier the direction changes but the wavelength
remains the same.
2
When the waves refract as they enter the shallow water the direction remains the
same, but the wavelength changes.
Which statements are correct?
A
statement 1 and statement 2
B
statement 1 only
C
statement 2 only
D
neither statement 1 nor statement 2
